title: Lec-1: Syllabus of TOC(Theory of Computation) for GATE | UGC NTA NET | Imp Points
description:
#TheoryOfComputation #TOCByGateSmashers #automatatheory 

👉Subscribe to our new channel:https://www.youtube.com/@varunainashots

This video introduces the outline of computability and computational complexity theory. Topics include regular and context free grammar, finite and pushdown automata, turing machine, decidable and undecidable problems. It is important for competitive exams like
UGC NET, GATE, NIELIT scientist and other PSUs as well as college, university exams and placements, interviews also.

0:00 - Introduction

2:29 - Context Five Language and Push down automata

3:32 - Closure property and undecidability
